product_summary: Mechanical seals and sealing systems for rotary equipment. Website (rolonseals.com, About Us + product menu) lists: API seals (RBQ-FL, RBQ-RBQ, RB2B-RBQ, RBW+GSL, RXHH, RXRH), pusher seals (SSUO/SSUW, RY155, CSUO/CSUW, MSUO/MSUW, FSRO/FRO, RM7N, RY33, MSBO/MSBW, RH75, RHJ92/RHJ97, RCH891, RHRN, RH74D, RM74D, FRA, RRA), cartridge seals (ROCART SE/DE, RMBC, RCSS, RCDS, R610, R620, RHPV, R510, R520, RP50, RSB2), engineered seals (RANF, RSE2C, RSE1-RSE2, RSAF, RDMS, RSAB, RJC587, RJCS1-RJCS2, RBFP, REK, RUOP), agitator seals (DS/TB, DVRA, SVSH, DMS, GDS, GVS, RHPA, RVO), elastomer bellow (RB10, RB301, RB30, RB2100, RB502, RMG1/12/13), PTFE bellow (TBSG, TBR/S/C, TB10T/10R), metal bellow (MBO, MBG, MBS, MBH), Sundyne pump seals, split seals, special pump seals. Also 'Seal Support System' line: flow control devices, cyclone separators, magnetic separators, thermosyphon pots, API Plans 21/23/32/52/53A/53B/53C/54/65A/65B/72/74/75/76. Also a 'Segmented Carbon' product category (page returned 404 on direct fetch, so contents unverified). Group companies listed: Macro Engineering Works, Target Equipments and Machines, Fluid-Science Dynamics, Global Sinter Products Pvt Ltd, Dongxin India Pvt Ltd, Himalaya Carbon.
comment: HS 848420 ('mechanical seals') is the correct and dominant heading for the core product line — the declared code is right for the main business, so match_status is partial rather than wrong: the declaration covers only the seals themselves and omits the rest of the catalogue. Missing from the declaration: (1) seal support systems / API piping plans — flow control devices, cyclone and magnetic separators, thermosyphon pots — these are apparatus, not seals, and would fall outside 848420 (likely 8419/8421/8481 family depending on the item; cannot be pinned to HS-6 without a customs line); (2) 'Segmented Carbon' — carbon/graphite seal rings and segments, which if sold as separate carbon articles would sit in 6815 (681510) rather than 848420; page 404 on direct fetch, so contents unverified; (3) interchangeable spares/refurbishment service for John Crane, Eagleburgmann, Flowserve, Ekato seals — a service line, not a goods line. Industry classification 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is a misclassification: the site lists Mining & Minerals only as one of twelve end-user industries served (alongside oil & gas, power, chemical, pharma, food, pulp & paper, water). The company is a mechanical-seal / rotating-equipment components manufacturer, not a metals or mining company. Trader signs: none — site states own factory at Plot No. 9, Road No. 1, IDA Mallapur, Hyderabad 500076 (50,000 sq ft, CNC machines, in-house API-682 4th Ed. test facility, ISO certified), plus own plants at Baroda (Vadodara) and Vizag, and overseas entities in Indonesia, UAE (Sharjah FZE), Malaysia, Saudi Arabia and Thailand. This is a manufacturer profile, though the site also says 'Manufacturing and Distribution', so a distribution component cannot be excluded. All product claims above are from the company's own website and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was available to me in this task to corroborate any specific code. No registry, revenue or shipment data researched per role scope.
